description:
WHAT: Chat-specific WebSocket frame parsing and stream control (after GAP-02 adds raw field to WsFrame::Unknown).

ALGORITHM:
1. Create crate-jmap-chat-client/src/ws.rs
2. Define ChatWsFrame enum:
   pub enum ChatWsFrame {
     StateChange(jmap_base_client::push::StateChange),
     Response(jmap_types::JmapResponse),
     ChatTyping(jmap_chat_types::ChatTypingEvent),
     ChatPresence(jmap_chat_types::ChatPresenceEvent),
     Unknown { type_name: String },
   }
3. Define fn parse_chat_ws_frame(frame: jmap_base_client::WsFrame) -> ChatWsFrame:
   - Match on frame:
     * WsFrame::StateChange(sc) → ChatWsFrame::StateChange(sc)
     * WsFrame::Response(r) → ChatWsFrame::Response(r)
     * WsFrame::Unknown { type_name, raw } where type_name == "ChatTypingEvent" → deserialize raw as ChatTypingEvent, on error → Unknown
     * WsFrame::Unknown { type_name, raw } where type_name == "ChatPresenceEvent" → deserialize raw as ChatPresenceEvent, on error → Unknown
     * WsFrame::Unknown { type_name, .. } → ChatWsFrame::Unknown { type_name }
4. Extension methods on jmap_base_client::WsSession via a trait ChatWsExt:
   pub trait ChatWsExt { 
     async fn next_chat_frame(&mut self) -> Option<Result<ChatWsFrame, ClientError>>;
     async fn send_stream_enable(&mut self, enable: &jmap_chat_types::ChatStreamEnable) -> Result<(), ClientError>;
     async fn send_stream_disable(&mut self) -> Result<(), ClientError>;
   }
   impl ChatWsExt for jmap_base_client::WsSession { ... }
   - next_chat_frame: calls self.next_frame().await.map(|r| r.map(parse_chat_ws_frame))
   - send_stream_enable: serde_json::to_value(enable)? then send_json
   - send_stream_disable: send_json(&json!({"@type": "ChatStreamDisable"}))
5. Declare in lib.rs: pub mod ws; pub use ws::{ChatWsFrame, ChatWsExt};

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- Deserialization failures on Unknown raw → return Unknown (never panic, never propagate)
- send_stream_enable: return Err on serialization failure (? operator)

TESTS (oracles from spec):
- parse_state_change_frame: WsFrame::StateChange → ChatWsFrame::StateChange
- parse_response_frame: WsFrame::Response → ChatWsFrame::Response
- parse_typing_frame: WsFrame::Unknown { type_name: ChatTypingEvent, raw: {...} } → ChatWsFrame::ChatTyping
- parse_presence_frame: same for ChatPresenceEvent
- parse_unknown_frame: unrecognized type_name → ChatWsFrame::Unknown
- parse_typing_malformed: type_name ChatTypingEvent but bad raw → ChatWsFrame::Unknown

ACCEPTANCE: 6 named tests pass; cargo test -p jmap-chat-client passes; clippy clean
title: jmap-chat-client: ws.rs — ChatWsFrame enum, stream enable/disable
